en.headline: CLP fault cuts power to about 1,000 Ho Man Tin customers
en.dek: Equipment near Waterloo Road failed at about 11.18pm; an elderly man on an oxygen machine was taken to hospital and firefighters freed two lifts.
body: CLP Power said equipment near Waterloo Road in Kowloon City failed at about 11.18pm on Wednesday, cutting electricity to about 1,000 customers in Ho Man Tin and nearby Mong Kok streets. Blocks along Waterloo Road, including Lung Cheung Building, Tsang Yung Building, Freedom Building and Chi Ling Building, plus buildings on Ho Man Tin Street and the Metropark Hotel Kowloon, lost supply.

Police said they received three reports between 11.36pm and 11.50pm and that no one was injured in those calls. Firefighters reported at least two lift entrapments. An elderly man in Chi Ling Building who relies on an oxygen machine was taken to hospital after the device stopped; reports said he remained conscious.

CLP said repair crews and mobile generators were sent to restore supply and that community support staff were coordinating with the District Office, councillors and property managers, including emergency lighting and portable batteries for care homes. Some residents said power had returned to parts of the area by about 4am. Street lamps on Argyle Street, Yim Po Fong Street and Shantung Street were also reported dark. The company has not given a cause beyond an equipment fault.

zh.headline: 窩打老道中電設備故障 約千戶停電
zh.dek: 昨晚約十一時十八分九龍城窩打老道附近設備故障，何文田及附近約一千客戶受影響，氧氣機停頓老翁送院，消防接至少兩宗升降機困人。
body: 中電表示，九月三十日晚上約十一時十八分，位於九龍城區窩打老道附近的供電設備出現故障，約一千名客戶電力供應中斷，範圍包括何文田窩打老道一帶多幢大廈，以及何文田街部分樓宇和九龍維景酒店。受影響地址包括龍翔大廈、曾榕大廈、自由大廈及芝齡大廈等。
警方表示，昨晚十一時三十六分至十一時五十分接獲三宗相關報案，該等報案無人受傷。消防處至少接獲兩宗升降機困人報告。芝齡大廈一名日常依靠氧氣機呼吸的老翁，因機器停頓不適，清醒被送院檢驗。
中電指正全力搶修，並調動多部流動發電機，社區支援隊及客戶經理與民政處、區議員及物管公司協調，同時向受影響院舍及樓宇提供流動電池及緊急照明。部分住戶表示今晨約四時已恢復供電。亞皆老街、染布房街及山東街一帶街燈亦曾熄滅。中電尚未公布故障的具體成因。
